raw_read_scope: Only wing_phase, encoder_count, hall_event, flap_frequency in existing A/B target plus 2s context; no IMU re-extraction or September audit
cycle_definition: No hall_event recorded in A/B. Use positive-going 2pi crossings of unwrapped valid phase, interpolate crossing timestamps; labels are encoder/Hall-referenced phase cycles, NOT directly observed Hall events.
weights: Equal total weight per training cycle; least squares with rank/condition recorded. No empirical noise precision claim.
phase_control: Same local basis dimension; replace measured phase by constant-rate clock phase or deterministic independent random offset per cycle. A global phase offset is not a valid negative control.
evaluation: Native-time held complete cycles; axis/vector RMSE, training-mean-normalized explained SSE, per-cycle harmonic amplitudes/phases, first/second half, fixed frequency bands [0,4,5,inf], slow gyro-mean norm <0.3 versus >=0.3 rad/s; all strata descriptive
no_leakage: IMU held cycles excluded from every coefficient/mean/bin fit; measured wing phase allowed as exogenous input. No phase refit from held IMU. Sparse Stage02 holdouts are not comparable independent scores.
stage_gate: Proceed to phase-motion/measurement-model synthetic checks when held-cycle repeated structure improves over no-phase baseline and phase controls in both A/B on predeclared dominant accel-z and gyro-y. Report failures on other axes. No real joint phase allocation without evidence restricting motion versus nuisance ambiguity.
synthetic_checks: variable phase and amplitude chain-rule p/v/a
independent numerical integration and knot boundaries
scientific_boundary: Regression is a sensor decomposition, not a reconstructed rigid-body trajectory. Synthetic checks do not establish actual phase C2 differentiability or physical allocation. No formal labels, no neural training, no Stage03.
phase_plan_amendment: Before regression outcomes: targeted extraction found no hall_event. Preserve original frozen_config.json; this revision specifies logged-phase crossing proxy and requires reporting Hall-event uncertainty.
